input.title: BH | Premier Alpbach Acacia and Iron Bench — In Almond
input.descriptionHtml:
In the old wooden houses of Alpbach, high in the Tyrol, supper is eaten in the panelled living room, with a long bench along the table and everyone sliding along it to make room for one more. This bench is made for that crowded, convivial table. At more than six and a half feet long it seats a row of family along one side of a dining table, and it is built for being used every day.

The seat is acacia, a dense hardwood with a lively grain, in a warm, light finish, set off with iron accents forged by hand in a dark finish. At 160 lbs it stays steady as people climb in and out. It arrives fully assembled.

Pull it up to a long kitchen table with a row of children along it, set it in an entry with boots and baskets beneath, or place it at the foot of a bed with a folded quilt and the next day's clothes laid out on it. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Ketchum Leather Ottoman — In Cognac
input.descriptionHtml:
Ernest Hemingway spent his last years in Ketchum, Idaho, where a day out in the hills ends with boots off and feet up by the fire in a room of worn leather and books. This ottoman is made for putting your feet up like that. It is small enough to pull close to any chair, sturdy enough to perch on when the room fills up, and its leather softens and deepens in colour with each winter of use.

It is covered in aniline leather, a top grade cowhide dyed right through rather than coated, so it keeps its natural grain and builds a patina over the years. A row of oversized brass nailheads trims it, and it arrives fully assembled.

Pull it up in front of a leather armchair in a den or a reading corner, or at the foot of a bed, with a folded blanket on it in winter and a tray for coffee when someone needs a table. This listing is for one ottoman.

input.title: BH | Premier Barnes Tufted Leather Ottoman — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
A Saturday walk around the pond in Barnes, the green Thames-side village in southwest London, ends best at home with your feet up, a pot of coffee, and the weekend papers spread out in front of you. This ottoman is made for that well-earned rest. Its round leather top is deep-buttoned and padded, soft to put your feet on, and at 36 inches across there is room for two people to stretch out their legs at once.

It is covered in full grain goat leather, the strongest part of the hide, left whole so it wears beautifully, and tufted all over with leather-covered buttons that draw the top into soft hollows. It stands on a wood frame at 16 inches, the height of a sofa seat, so it doubles as an extra place to sit when friends come over. It arrives fully assembled.

Pull it up in front of a sofa or a pair of fireside chairs, with a wool throw nearby and a stack of magazines on the floor beside it. This listing is for one ottoman.

input.title: BH | Premier Le Panier Leather and Iron Stool — In Cognac with Jet Frame
input.descriptionHtml:
Above the Old Port, in the Provençal harbour city that has long been France's gateway to North Africa, people carry a seat out to wherever the light and the conversation are best: a terrace, a doorway, a corner of the kitchen. This leather and iron stool is made to move like that. At 23 lbs and 20 inches wide it lifts easily with one hand, so it goes from the hall to the fireside to a spare place at the table without a second thought.

The frame is iron with a powder coating, a baked-on finish that is tougher than paint, and the seat is leather that softens and darkens with use. It is rated to hold up to 220 lbs. At 19 inches high it works as an extra seat, a footrest or a perch for a stack of books. It arrives in one box and needs assembly.

Keep it beside a reading chair as a footstool, at the end of a bed for pulling on boots, or in a hall ready to bring out when friends arrive. This listing is for one stool.

In a Back Bay brownstone, the front hall sees the whole day go by: boots pulled on in the morning, guests greeted in the evening, and a moment to sit before heading out into Boston. This bench is made for those comings and goings. Its upholstered linen seat gives you a soft place to sit while you lace up or wait for a ride, and its slim 15-inch depth keeps the hall clear.

The base is oak in a whitewashed finish, and the seat is covered in linen, a natural fabric with a gentle, textured weave. At almost four feet long, there is room to sit with a bag beside you, and at 23 pounds it is easy to carry to the dining table when extra places are needed. It arrives fully assembled.

Place it in an entry hall below a row of hooks, at the foot of a bed with a folded throw, or along one side of a dining table with a basket of napkins nearby. This listing is for one bench.

This hall bench is made for that coming and going. Its leather seat gives you somewhere comfortable to sit while you tie a lace or wait for a taxi, and at 30 inches wide it fits even a narrow hall.

The seat is leather over an iron frame with clean, straight lines, a pairing that suits a traditional house and a modern apartment equally well. At 19 inches high it is an easy height to sit down on and stand up from, and at 18 inches deep there is room to set a bag down beside you while you find your keys. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it in an entry under a row of hooks, with a basket for shoes beneath and an umbrella stand close by, or at the foot of a bed for laying out tomorrow's clothes. This listing is for one bench.

input.descriptionHtml:
Värnamo, in the forests of Småland, is the hometown of the Swedish designer whose bentwood chairs of the 1930s helped define Swedish modern, furniture shaped around the way a body actually sits. This stool carries that practical thinking into a small, useful piece. It is low and compact, ready to pull up for an extra guest, slide under a console or rest your feet on, and its leather seat is comfortable for a short sit while shoes are laced or a phone call is taken.

The seat is leather, set on an iron base in a soft pewter finish with brass details. At 21 inches high it is a comfortable sitting height, and at 36 lbs it is sturdy enough to feel planted yet easy to carry from room to room. It arrives fully assembled.

Tuck it under a console in an entry for putting on shoes, set it at the end of a bed, or keep it beside an armchair as a spot for a book and a cup of coffee when nobody is sitting on it. This listing is for one stool.

Set it in an entry hall below a row of coat hooks, with a basket for umbrellas and the dog's leash within reach, or under a bedroom window with a folded throw across the seat. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Saffron Walden Tufted Linen Bench — In Cream
input.descriptionHtml:
Coming in on a wet evening to an old Saffron Walden house, the first thing anyone needs is somewhere to sit and pull the boots off before supper. This bench is made for that moment by the door. Its long seat gives the whole family a place to perch at once, it is padded and buttoned so you can linger, and a ring handle at each end gives two people a grip to move it.

The seat is upholstered in a soft linen and tufted all the way along, and the frame is American oak in a natural finish that shows its grain. It sits 18 inches high, the height of a dining chair seat, so it can move from the hall to the table when guests come. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it in an entryway under a row of coat hooks, with a basket for boots beneath, or pull it up to a long dining table across from a run of chairs. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Taormina Leather and Iron Bench — In Cream with Jet Frame
input.descriptionHtml:
Taormina was built for looking: from its terraces and the old Greek theatre on the hill you see Etna on one side and the sea on the other, and people sit side by side facing the view. This bench brings that shared view indoors, made for two to sit together at a window or the foot of a bed. Its seat runs 58 inches wide between arms at each end, so there is room for two to settle in, and its soft leather invites a long look out.

The seat is napa leather, a soft, supple leather, on a frame of iron in a dark gunmetal finish, with accents hammered by hand that catch the light along its lines. A 19-inch seat height and 22-inch seat depth make it a seat to stay on rather than perch. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it under a bedroom window with a cushion and a throw, at the foot of a bed for laying out the next day's clothes, or in a hall facing a window where guests can sit to take off their shoes. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Bamberg Leather Cushion Bench — In Cognac with Jet Base
input.descriptionHtml:
In Bamberg, the Franconian town known for its smoked beer, evenings are spent in old timbered taverns where there is always a seat to be found for one more. This little bench brings that easy hospitality home. Its padded leather seat is the right size to pull up for an extra guest, and when nobody needs it, it works just as well as a footrest beside a favourite chair.

The seat is a leather cushion, firm enough to sit on and soft enough to rest your feet on, set on a frame of old wood with an iron base that crosses in an X beneath it. At 18 inches high it matches the seat of most dining chairs, and at just 30 lbs it moves easily around the room. It arrives fully assembled.

Keep it under a console in the hall, at the end of a bed, or tucked by the dining table, ready to pull up when another guest arrives. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Coburg Tufted Leather Bench — In Cognac
input.descriptionHtml:
In the old Franconian town of Coburg, below the castle on its hill, winter afternoons are for staying in with a book, and a seat by the window with good light is the best place in the house. This bench brings that window seat home. Its tufted leather top is broad enough to settle back on with a book, and at more than five feet long it has room for two to share the light.

The leather is pure aniline top grain, dyed right through so the natural markings of the hide show, and button tufting holds it in neat, padded sections. Aniline leather feels soft from the first day and deepens in colour as it is used. It ships in one slim box and needs assembly.

Place it under a window in a library or study with a stack of books at one end and a lamp close by, at the foot of a bed with a folded blanket, or in front of a fireplace as extra seating when friends come. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Sheffield Leather Soccer Ball Stool
input.descriptionHtml:
Sheffield FC, founded in 1857, is recognized as the world's oldest soccer club, and in that city the match is still watched the old way: in a crowd of friends, everyone leaning forward at the big moments. This stool is made for game day at home. It is shaped and stitched like an old-fashioned leather match ball, low and round, so it is an extra seat on the edge of the circle or a footrest when the replay is on.

It is covered all over in leather, which softens a little more with every season of use. At 18 inches high it is a comfortable seat for one, and its 22-inch round shape makes it broad and steady. It weighs 29 lbs, so it is easy to carry to wherever the game is on, and it arrives fully assembled.

Put it in a den or a teenager's room in front of the television, beside a leather sofa as a spare seat, or in a study as a footrest. This listing is for one stool.

input.title: BH | Premier Ubrique Crocodile-Embossed Leather Stool
input.descriptionHtml:
Ubrique, one of the white towns in the hills of Cádiz, has lived by leather for centuries, and its workshops still cut, emboss and stitch fine goods by hand. This stool carries that craft of small, well-made things into a room, made for perching: at a dressing table, at the foot of a bed while pulling on boots, or in front of a chair with your feet up. Its square seat is a comfortable size, and its embossed leather has the look of a fine bag or belt.

The leather is pressed with a crocodile pattern, which gives it a deep, scaled texture, and it is built with wood beneath. At 18 inches square and 19.5 tall it sits at an easy seat height, light enough to carry from room to room. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it at a vanity with a mirror above, at the foot of a bed with a folded throw on top, or beside a sofa as a spare seat with a tray for a drink. This listing is for one stool.

input.title: BH | Premier Aachen Tufted Leather Long Stool — In Cognac with Jet Base
input.descriptionHtml:
Aachen has been a spa city since Roman times, and the mornings there keep a spa's pace: a slow start, an unhurried bath, and no rush at all to get dressed. This long stool is made for that slow routine at the foot of the bed, a place to sit and pull on shoes or lay out tomorrow's clothes. Its tufted leather seat runs 52 inches, long enough for two to sit side by side, and its slim metal base keeps it light to the eye.

The seat is aniline cowhide, leather dyed right through without a heavy surface coating, so it feels soft and supple and deepens in character as it is used. It is tufted across its length and stands 20 inches high on a dark metal base. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it at the foot of a bed with a folded throw and the next day's sweater on it, in a hall where people stop to take off boots, or in front of a sofa with a tray as a low table. This listing is for one long stool.

Around the Curragh in County Kildare, horse country for centuries, the day begins in the mudroom: a seat by the door, boots pulled on one at a time, and out to the gallops in the early mist. This small bench is made for that moment of getting ready. It is just the right height to sit on while you lace boots or buckle a strap, and compact enough to fit inside a front door or at the foot of a bed.

It pairs hand-forged iron with leather. The iron gives it a strong frame with the subtle marks of the forge, and the leather seat is comfortable and softens with years of use. At 26 inches wide it is a generous seat for one. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it by the front door with a boot tray beneath and a hook for coats above, or place a pair at the foot of a bed, or pull one up to join a conversation by the fire. This listing is for one bench.

input.title: BH | Premier Noirmoutier Linen Ottomans, Set of 2 — In Cream
input.descriptionHtml:
On Noirmoutier, the island off the Vendée coast reached at low tide along a causeway the sea covers twice a day, summer houses fill with family, and seats are always being carried from one room to another. These ottomans are made for that easy shuffle. They serve as a footrest after a day cycling past the salt marshes, a seat at the dressing table, or two extra places when the cousins arrive.

Each one has an oak frame in a natural finish, dressed in linen with a pleated skirt and exposed upholstery tacks, and its welted cushion, edged with a fine piped seam, is fixed to the seat, so it stays neat however often it is moved. The pair come together and arrive fully assembled.

Set them at the foot of a bed, under a console in a hall, or in front of the fire in a living room with a basket of blankets nearby, ready to be pulled up when the room fills. This set includes two ottomans.

input.descriptionHtml:
Around 1900 the artists of Darmstadt's Mathildenhöhe colony set out to rethink the whole home, from the chairs to the door handles, in a fresh and modern way. This ottoman carries that thinking into the living room, made for putting your feet up at the end of the day. Its long upholstered top has room for two pairs of feet or a tray of tea, and it doubles as extra seating when friends come over.

The upholstery is bouclé, a fabric woven from looped yarn that gives a soft, nubby texture, set on a frame of polished stainless steel that adds a quick gleam at floor level. More than four feet long, it fits neatly in front of a full-size sofa. Bouclé is soft to touch and adds texture to a room of smooth surfaces. It arrives fully assembled.

Set it before a sofa in a living room or at the foot of a bed, with a tray holding a teapot and a book or two. This listing is for one ottoman.

input.title: BH | Premier Cromford Mahogany Bench — In Cocoa
input.descriptionHtml:
In the stone cottages Richard Arkwright built for his mill workers at Cromford, in Derbyshire, supper meant a whole family squeezed along one long table. This bench is made for that kind of table. At six feet long it seats a row of people down one side of a dining table, children and grown-ups shoulder to shoulder, and it slides neatly under the top when the meal is done.

It is mahogany, a dense hardwood with a warm, close grain, made in a plain, sturdy form. At 14 inches deep it is narrow enough to tuck into a hall or along the foot of a bed, and its 18-inch seat height matches most dining chairs, so it sits comfortably at the same table. It needs some assembly.

Pull it up to a long farmhouse table with plates and bread passed along, or put it in a mudroom under the coat hooks for pulling boots on, with a basket of scarves and gloves stowed underneath. This listing is for one bench.

Galway is a city of music and seafood, and dinner there with friends tends to run long: a bowl of mussels, a pint or a glass of white, and a tune started up before the plates are even cleared. This dining chair is made for staying put through all of it. Its shaped back gives you something to lean into between courses, and its leather seat is comfortable enough to keep you at the table long after dessert has gone around.

It combines top grain leather with a rubberwood frame and iron, a sturdy mix that wears well in a dining room used every day. Leather is a practical choice at the table: spills blot away and it softens with use. At 32 lbs it is easy to pull out and push back in. It arrives fully assembled.

Set four or six around a farmhouse table or a round pedestal table, with a pot of mussels, crusty bread and candles in the middle, or use one at a desk in a study. This listing is for one dining chair.

In Saint-Jean-de-Luz, on France's Basque coast, the table is dressed in Basque linen, the striped cloth woven in the region for generations, and lunch is taken slowly. This dining armchair brings that dressed-table ease home, made for sitting long at the head of the table. Its linen skirt falls neatly to the floor, a seat cushion and a matching kidney-shaped pillow at the back ease you in, and its arms give you somewhere to rest between courses.

The wood frame is fully upholstered in linen, tailored close to its shape, and the 21-inch seat height suits a standard dining table. At 27 lbs it is light enough to draw up and push back with ease, and the cushion and pillow make it as comfortable for coffee after lunch as for the meal itself. It arrives fully assembled.

Use a pair at the head and foot of a dining table with plainer side chairs between, or set one at a writing desk or in a bedroom corner, with a cushion of Basque stripes for colour. This listing is for one dining armchair.

This dining chair is made for staying through every course. Its upholstered seat keeps you comfortable from the first glass to the last, and its dark oak frame has the solid, settled look of a family table that has seen many such evenings.

The frame is oak in a deep, dark finish, and the upholstery is a polyester linen fabric, which has the soft, natural texture of linen and stands up well to everyday meals. A 20-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, and the 17-inch seat depth keeps you sitting comfortably upright to eat and talk. It arrives fully assembled.

Set a full run of them around a dining table for weekend dinners, with candles, a big bowl of pasta and the bread passed down the line, or use a pair at the ends of a table with a bench along one side. This listing is for one dining chair.

input.title: BH | Premier Bergerac Upholstered Dining Chair — In Cream with Jet Legs
input.descriptionHtml:
In Bergerac, the old wine town on the Dordogne, dinner is unhurried: a bottle of the local red, a few courses, and the table cleared only when the conversation runs out. This dining chair is made for staying seated that long. Its upholstery is soft to sit on through every course, and its trim frame keeps the table from feeling crowded when every seat is taken.

The frame is maple, a hard, close-grained wood, and the upholstery is a blend of cotton and linen, with linen's natural texture and cotton's softness. Its 19-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, the seat is 18 inches wide, and at 23 lbs it is easy to draw in and out. It arrives fully assembled.

Arrange several around a farmhouse table with a bottle of wine, a basket of bread and candles down the middle, or use one at a writing desk in a study where its soft seat is welcome through a long letter. This listing is for one dining chair.

input.title: BH | Premier Valencia Leather High-Back Dining Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
Valencia is the home of paella, and a Valencian Sunday lunch begins the day before at the city's great central market, buying rice, beans and saffron, and ends hours later around the pan at the table. These dining chairs are made for those long lunches. Their tall backs give you something to lean back into between helpings, and the seats sit at 20 inches, a good height for a standard dining table.

They are upholstered in top grain leather, the strong outer layer of the hide, which wipes clean after a messy meal and softens with use. Each seat is 21 inches wide, room to settle in for the long haul of a family lunch. Each high back rises to 46 inches, giving the chairs a stately outline around the table. They arrive fully assembled.

Place them at the head and foot of a dining table, or set pairs down both sides, with the paella pan in the middle, a bowl of lemons close by and a jug of water within reach of every place. This set includes two dining chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Staithes Upholstered Captain's Dining Chair
input.descriptionHtml:
In Staithes, the North Yorkshire fishing village where a young James Cook worked in a shop before he went to sea, supper is a family affair, and someone always takes the chair at the head of the table. This captain's chair is made for that place. Its tall back, rising to 49 inches, gives it a natural presence, and its arms, upholstered seat and generous 20.5-inch seat depth let whoever sits there settle in for the whole meal.

The frame is beech, a close-grained, hard-wearing hardwood, and the seat is upholstered. Its 18-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, and the arms rise to 26.5 inches, just where your elbows rest between courses. At 25 inches wide it sits comfortably at the end of most tables. It arrives fully assembled.

Set one at the head of a dining table, or a pair at both ends with side chairs between, with the roast on a board and the candles lit; one also makes a handsome desk chair in a study. This listing is for one captain's chair.

input.title: BH | Premier Noirmoutier Sailcloth Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Cream
input.descriptionHtml:
Supper in a Noirmoutier summer house is a crowded, happy business: fish from the harbour or a dish of the island's small new potatoes, everyone squeezed around the table, and the shutters open to the sea air. This pair of side chairs is made to fit that crowd. They are slim, just 16 inches wide, so another place can always be squeezed in, and their tall backs and soft skirts bring a dressed-up note to an easygoing meal.

Each chair is covered all over in sailcloth, a sturdy, closely woven cloth, falling to a pleated skirt. The back rises well above the seat, a straight and steady place to lean through a long meal. The 19-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, and they arrive fully assembled.

Set them at the ends of a dining table laid for a crowd, at a small table in a kitchen corner with the bread board and a jug of water, or one on each side of a console in a hall, ready to join the table when more guests come. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Hove Bamboo-Style Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
When the Prince Regent remade his Royal Pavilion, just along the shore from Hove, he filled it with chairs carved and painted to look like bamboo, a taste that became one of the signatures of the Regency. These side chairs carry that Regency dinner to your own table, made for sitting down to a meal and staying for the talk. Their slender carved frames pull up close without crowding, and their linen seats keep everyone comfortable from the first course to the last.

Each chair is carved by hand from birch, with the rings of bamboo picked out along the frame, and the seat is upholstered in linen. The 20-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, and the chairs are light enough to lift and move when the table is cleared. They arrive fully assembled.

Set a pair at the ends of a dining table, or line several down both sides for a full table, with candles lit, the good plates out and the serving dishes passed from hand to hand. Two also sit well either side of a hall console or at a writing desk. This set includes two side chairs.

When the Prince Regent remade his Royal Pavilion, just along the shore from Hove, he filled it with chairs carved and painted to look like bamboo, a taste that became one of the signatures of the Regency. These side chairs carry that Regency dinner to your own table, made for sitting down to a meal and staying for the talk. Their slender carved frames pull up close without crowding, and their linen seats keep everyone comfortable from the first course to the last.

Each chair is carved by hand from birch, with the rings of bamboo picked out along the frame, and the seat is upholstered in linen. The 20-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, and the chairs are light enough to lift and move when the table is cleared. They arrive fully assembled.

Set a pair at the ends of a dining table, or line several down both sides for a full table, with candles lit, the good plates out and the serving dishes passed from hand to hand. Two also sit well either side of a hall console or at a writing desk. This set includes two side chairs.

Supper in a tall house on Brunswick Square in Hove runs late, the windows open to the sea air and the guests still talking at midnight over the last of the wine. These side chairs are made for that kind of table. Their carved frames are easy to draw up or push back between courses, and their upholstered seats keep the evening comfortable until the candles burn down.

Each frame is birch, carved by hand with the rings and joints of bamboo and finished in paint, and the seat is covered in sailcloth, a close, sturdy woven fabric first made to stand up to wind and weather. At 20 inches, the seat sits at the usual height for a dining table, and both chairs come ready to use, with no assembly.

Put a pair at the head and foot of a table for dinner with candles and the serving dishes, or set them around a small round table in a breakfast room with the coffee pot and the morning bread. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Burnham Market Linen Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Cream with Cocoa Frame
input.descriptionHtml:
Burnham Market is a village of handsome Georgian houses around a green near the north Norfolk coast, and dinner there is a long, easy affair with friends: local mussels or crab, a second bottle opened, and nobody watching the clock. These side chairs are made for staying on at the table like that. Their fully curved backs hold you comfortably as the evening goes on, and their linen covers are cool and soft to lean against.

The frames are ash, a strong, springy hardwood, upholstered all over in pure linen. Each seat is 18 inches deep with a 20-inch seat height, a comfortable fit at a standard dining table, and the graceful line of the back gives a dining room a calm, settled look. They arrive fully assembled.

Gather them around a dining table under a chandelier, with linen napkins, candles and a big platter of seafood in the middle, or put the pair at either end of a long table to frame it. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Saint Peter Port Oval-Back Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
In Saint Peter Port, the French novelist who finished Les Misérables in exile on Guernsey furnished Hauteville House room by room himself, and his dining room was made for company. These oval-backed side chairs are made for that kind of table, where dinner is the main event and guests stay for hours. Their oval backs give a soft, rounded line to lean against, and their deep, upholstered seats make the long meal a comfortable one.

Seat and back are upholstered and finished with double welting, a twin line of piping that traces each edge and gives the chairs a tailored look. The seat is a generous 21 inches deep and 21 inches high, and with no arms the chairs slide neatly under the table edge. They arrive fully assembled.

Arrange them around an oval or round dining table laid with candles, crystal and a dish of shellfish, or use a pair at either side of a writing desk or console in a hall. This set includes two side chairs.

These oval-backed side chairs are made for that kind of table, where dinner is the main event and guests stay for hours. Their oval backs give a soft, rounded line to lean against, and their deep, upholstered seats make the long meal a comfortable one.

Seat and back are upholstered and finished with double welting, a twin line of piping that traces each edge and gives the chairs a tailored look. The seat is a generous 21 inches deep and 21 inches high, and with no arms the chairs slide neatly under the table edge. They arrive fully assembled.

input.title: BH | Premier Elie Cane-Back Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Amber with Navy Seat
input.descriptionHtml:
In Elie, on the Fife coast, a harbour house supper means fresh fish, a view of the sea through the window and a table that friends are slow to leave. These side chairs are made for those long, lingering dinners. A woven cane panel gives each back a light, open place to lean, and the upholstered seat, set at 20 inches, sits at a comfortable height for an ordinary dining table.

Each frame is solid ash, and the legs are carved by hand with fine flutes, the narrow grooves that run along their length, a detail borrowed from classical architecture. The back panel is woven from fine cane skin, and the seat is covered in fabric. Light enough to move easily, the pair can follow the party from dining table to hall. They arrive fully assembled.

Pull them up to a dining table set with a platter of smoked fish, a bowl of new potatoes and a jug of wildflowers, or set the pair at a hall table. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Dundee Woven Jute Chair — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
In the 1800s Dundee became the world's great jute city, spinning fibre shipped from Bengal into sacking, rope and canvas, and the warm, rough feel of jute still says honest work. This chair puts that texture where you can enjoy it, made for an unhurried hour with a book or a cup of coffee. Its woven jute rope brings that natural, handmade texture into the room, and its frame keeps it sturdy and steady.

The frame is acacia, a dense hardwood, and its lines borrow from a classic Chinese chair form, reworked for a modern room. At 22 lbs it moves easily from a bedroom to a reading corner to the end of a dining table, and it arrives fully assembled.

Put it in a reading corner beside a lamp, with a small table for a mug and a basket of books at its feet, or at a desk in a study, where it can be drawn up for a visitor and set back against the wall afterwards. This listing is for one chair.

input.title: BH | Premier Vernazza Round-Back Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Cocoa with Cream Upholstery
input.descriptionHtml:
Lunch in Vernazza is eaten close to the water, at tables squeezed into the little harbour square, with grilled fish, a plate of anchovies and a carafe of white wine, and nobody in a hurry to leave. These side chairs are made for that kind of long, easy lunch. Their rounded backs curve around you as you lean back between courses, and at 18 inches wide they slip in close around a small table, so nobody is left out of the talk.

The frames are beechwood, a close-grained hardwood that holds its shape well through years of being pulled in and out. The seat sits 19 inches from the floor and runs 17 inches deep, a comfortable fit at a standard dining table. They arrive fully assembled.

Pull them up to a round kitchen table or a small dining table by a window, set with a bowl of lemons, a basket of bread, a jug of water and a dish of olives to pick at between courses. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Nancy Birch Cane-Seat Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Jet
input.descriptionHtml:
Nancy's brasseries are made for long, easy dinners: a plate of something good, a carafe of wine, and the room full of talk under the glass and woodwork the city's Art Nouveau makers left behind. These side chairs bring that brasserie table home. Their frames sweep in long, unbroken curves, the line the École de Nancy loved, and their padded cane seats keep you comfortable through a second course and the cheese that follows.

The frames are birch, and each seat is woven cane laid over padding, so the chairs keep the brasserie look while sitting softer than bare cane. At 20 inches wide they are generously scaled for a modern dining room, and the 18-inch seat height suits a standard dining table. They arrive fully assembled.

Bring them to a round breakfast table with a bread basket and a bottle of wine, or mix them around a dining table with a bench along one side. A pair also works at a small bistro table in a sunroom, set for coffee and the morning paper. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Nancy Bentwood Cane-Seat Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
In Nancy, the city where the École de Nancy made the curving line its own around 1900, a bentwood chair belongs at a long dinner table as naturally as the wine. These side chairs are made for that kind of unhurried meal. Their curved frames are light enough to pull in and out easily between courses, and their padded seats invite you to stay put for one more glass.

The frames are oak, bent into their curves rather than cut from straight timber. Each seat is woven cane laid over padding, so the open texture of the cane stays on show while the sit stays soft through a long meal. At a 19-inch seat height they suit most dining tables, and they arrive fully assembled.

Set them around a dining table with a linen cloth, candles and a dish of mussels in the middle, or use the pair at a café table by a kitchen window for breakfast and the crossword. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Giverny Oak and Linen Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Almond with Cream Seat
input.descriptionHtml:
At Giverny, the painter's yellow dining room was made for company: a long table, friends and family gathered around, and lunch stretching well into the afternoon. These side chairs are made for that kind of meal. Their backs are shaped from curving wood that meets you comfortably as you lean back between courses, and their linen seats are soft enough to keep everyone at the table for one more slice of tart.

The frames are oak in a whitewashed finish that lets the grain show through, and the seats are covered in linen. With a 19-inch seat height they sit right at a standard dining table, and their slim frames let several fit along one side. The seats are 17 inches deep, enough to sit back comfortably through a long meal. The pair arrives fully assembled.

Put them around a long farmhouse table with a jug of fresh-cut flowers and a bowl of cherries, or set the pair at either end of a table with a bench along the side. This set includes two side chairs.

These field chairs bring that dressed-up picnic spirit to the dining table. Their canvas and metal have the relaxed, practical look of furniture made for an outing, and a seat at 18 inches pulls you comfortably up to the table for a long meal.

Each chair has a metal frame with canvas upholstery, in the plain, useful lines of mid-century camp furniture. The seat is 20 inches wide and 17 deep, a good fit for a supper that runs on, and the pair arrives fully assembled.

Pull them up to a kitchen table or a round dining table with a jug of flowers and a picnic of cheese, bread and cold chicken, or set them on a sunporch for a long lunch in the light, with a pitcher of lemonade on the table. This set includes two field chairs.

Saint-Cloud climbs the hill above the Seine just west of Paris, and a dinner party in one of its old houses means a long table, the city lights in the distance and guests who linger over the cheese. These side chairs are made for those dinners. Their curved, tufted backs hold you comfortably through a long conversation, and their graceful lines bring a little of a French dining room to any table.

Each chair is upholstered in velvet, with button tufting across the inside of the back and a row of silver-toned nailheads, over an oak frame raised on legs in a dark finish. At 19 inches the seat sits at an easy height for most dining tables, and both chairs come fully assembled, ready for the first dinner party.

Set a pair at the head and foot of the dining table with candles and the good glasses out, or place them either side of a console in the hall, or at a writing desk in a bedroom, where one can sit at the desk and the other wait by the window. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Ascona Linen Wing-Back Dining Chairs, Set of 2 — In Cream with Chestnut Legs
input.descriptionHtml:
Summer dinners in Ascona are long ones, at tables on the lakefront of Lake Maggiore or in dining rooms with the windows thrown open to the water, where risotto and a bottle of Ticino Merlot keep everyone seated until the light goes. These dining chairs are made for lingering like that. Their high backs curve forward into wings at the sides, giving real support to lean into between courses, and at only 21 inches wide they fit around a table in numbers without crowding.

The frames are beech, a close-grained hardwood that is strong without bulk, and the seats and backs are upholstered in linen, with its soft, natural texture. A 20-inch seat height and a 17-inch seat depth make them right for a standard dining table, upright to eat and easy to settle back in for coffee. They arrive fully assembled.

Use several around a dining table laid with candles, linen napkins and a bowl of lemons, or set the pair at the ends of a long table with a bench along each side. This set includes two dining chairs.

This pair of side chairs is made for those long lakeside dinners. Their graceful backs rise tall enough to lean into between courses, and their curves keep a pair drawn up to the table looking light.

Each chair is made of beechwood, a close-grained hardwood well suited to curved forms. They stand 41 inches tall, with a 20-inch seat height and a 17-inch seat depth that suit a standard dining table, and the pair arrives fully assembled.

Draw them up to either side of a dining table, at the ends of a long table to frame a bench, or at a small round table by a window, set with two glasses, a candle and a bowl of olives for dinner for two. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Ascona Velvet High-Back Dining Chairs, Set of 2 — In Navy with Chestnut Legs
input.descriptionHtml:
When the evening cools off Lake Maggiore, dinner in Ascona moves indoors to rooms lit by candles, where a slow meal of fish from the lake and a glass of wine can run on until midnight. These high-backed dining chairs are made for that softer, later hour. Their tall backs rise well above the shoulders, so you can lean back between courses and still feel held, and their velvet upholstery brings warmth and a gentle sheen to the candlelight.

Seat and back are covered in polyester velvet, a hard-wearing velvet with a soft hand. The 20-inch seat height and 17-inch seat depth suit a standard dining table, so the meal can run long without anyone shifting in their seat. They arrive fully assembled.

Place them around a dining table set with a long runner, tall candles and a platter at the centre, or use the pair at either end of a table with lighter side chairs between. A single one also makes a handsome desk chair in a study, with a lamp and a stack of letters close by. This set includes two dining chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Meudon Oval Cane-Back Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
Rodin spent his last twenty years at a villa on the hill at Meudon, looking out over the Seine toward Paris, and lunch in a French house like his is a long, easy affair at a table by the window. These side chairs are made for those long lunches. Their oval backs of woven cane let air and light through, so they look light at the table, and their upholstered seats, 22 inches deep, keep you comfortable through cheese and coffee.

The frames are beechwood, a close-grained hardwood long favoured by French chairmakers, shaped with gently curved legs, and each oval back is cane, thin strips of rattan woven into a fine open mesh. The seats are upholstered tight, smooth and firm, with no loose cushion to slide. They arrive fully assembled.

Use them around a dining table in pairs, as extra chairs at a desk or a dressing table, or set one in a bedroom with a cardigan over its back. This set includes two side chairs.

Rodin spent his last twenty years at a villa on the hill at Meudon, looking out over the Seine toward Paris, and lunch in a French house like his is a long, easy affair at a table by the window. These side chairs are made for those long lunches. Their oval backs of woven cane let air and light through, so they look light at the table, and their upholstered seats, 22 inches deep, keep you comfortable through cheese and coffee.

The frames are beechwood, a close-grained hardwood long favoured by French chairmakers, shaped with gently curved legs, and each oval back is cane, thin strips of rattan woven into a fine open mesh. The seats are upholstered tight, smooth and firm, with no loose cushion to slide. They arrive fully assembled.

Use them around a dining table in pairs, as extra chairs at a desk or a dressing table, or set one in a bedroom with a cardigan over its back. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Saint-Cloud Tufted Leather Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Chestnut
input.descriptionHtml:
On Sunday mornings the park at Saint-Cloud, laid out on the slopes above the Seine, fills with walkers, and the walk ends back at a family table set for a long lunch. These side chairs are made for that table. Their curved, button-tufted backs give everyone somewhere comfortable to lean through the cheese and the coffee, and their firm, close-fitted leather seats keep you sitting well at the table.

Each chair is upholstered in leather over an oak frame, with tufting worked across the back and the seat fitted tight, with no loose cushion to plump. The legs carry a gentle curve. The seat sits 19 inches from the floor, a comfortable height for a standard dining table, and the pair is delivered fully assembled.

Set the two at the ends of a farmhouse table with a bowl of pears, a wedge of cheese on a board and the coffee pot, or put one at a writing desk in a study and the other beside it for a visitor who stops in to talk. This set includes two side chairs.

In Avignon, the city of the popes, July brings the theatre festival, and the best evenings begin with an early dinner near the Palais des Papes before the curtain goes up, the light still warm on the old stone. This pair of side chairs is made for those evenings at the table. Their leather seats and backs stay comfortable through a long dinner, and aged gold nailheads trace their classic outline, a little dressed up, like the evening itself.

Each chair is upholstered in leather over a frame in a walnut-tone finish, with a seat 19 inches deep and 19 high that suits a standard dining table. The leather softens with use and takes on more character over time. They arrive fully assembled.

Set them at a dining table with candles, a bottle of Côtes du Rhône and the cheese course still to come, or place one on each side of a console in a hall, where they wait for the next dinner party. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Grindelwald Cane-Back Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
In a chalet at Grindelwald, with the north face of the Eiger filling the window, supper is a long, warm affair: a pot of fondue, a bottle of white and nobody in a hurry to leave the table. These side chairs are made for staying at that table. Their cushioned seats stay comfortable through one course after another, and their woven cane backs give a light, open place to lean back between helpings.

Each chair is built from ash with a cane back woven by hand, and its seat is padded and covered in a linen performance fabric made to handle everyday dining. The frames have crisp, architectural lines softened by the warmth of natural materials. They arrive fully assembled.

Set them around a dining table in a kitchen or dining room, with a cast iron pot in the middle, a basket of bread and a candle in a jar, or put the pair at either end of a farmhouse table. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Hartford Velvet Parsons Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Greige with Espresso Legs
input.descriptionHtml:
The house in Hartford where Mark Twain and his family lived from 1874 was known for its hospitality, with guests kept at the dinner table late into the evening by stories and laughter. These side chairs are made for a dining room like that. Their tall, straight backs, at 40 inches, give a formal table a handsome line, and their velvet covers keep every seat soft and welcoming through the second hour of conversation.

They are Parsons chairs, the clean, fully upholstered form named for the New York design school, built on maple frames and covered in polyester velvet. The seat is 20 inches high and 16 inches deep, an upright, attentive fit for dining, and the chairs stand close together around a table without looking crowded. They arrive fully assembled.

Set them around a dining table with a white cloth, tall candles and a roast on the board, or use the pair at a writing desk and a dressing table in the next room. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Saint-Cloud Tufted Pigskin Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Dove
input.descriptionHtml:
In the old houses of Saint-Cloud, looking back across the Seine toward Paris, a weeknight supper with the neighbours is a simple thing: a roast chicken, a green salad, a bottle opened and the talk carrying on long after the plates are cleared. These side chairs are made for those easy evenings. Their softly curved, tufted backs give everyone a comfortable place to lean, so nobody is in a hurry to get up.

Each chair is covered in pigskin, a supple leather with a fine pattern of tiny pores across its surface, over a wood frame, and buttons draw the leather of the back into neat tufts. The seat is 19 inches high, which suits a standard dining table, and the chairs come ready to use with no assembly.

Put them at either end of a kitchen table with the salad bowl and a basket of bread between them, or pair them across a small round table in a window for morning coffee and the newspaper. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Roubaix Curved Upholstered Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
In Roubaix, where the 1932 swimming baths now hold the museum called La Piscine, the decade's taste for curves you can live with is still plain to see. These side chairs bring those curves to a dinner table where friends linger. Their gently curved backs hold you comfortably, and their deep, well-cushioned seats invite guests to stay for one more course and another round of stories.

The frames are beechwood, a strong hardwood with a fine, even grain that holds a curve well, and both seat and back are upholstered, with extra cushioning in the seat for comfort that lasts. The seat is 20 inches deep and 21 inches high, deep enough to settle back into between courses and high enough to sit comfortably at a standard dining table. They arrive fully assembled.

Arrange them around a round dining table with a low bowl of flowers and candles, or set a pair at a small breakfast table in a bay window. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Dessau Oak Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
The designers who worked in Dessau in the 1920s taught that a chair should be simple, sturdy and honest about how it is made, and that is exactly what a good dining chair needs to be. These side chairs are made in that spirit, for sitting up at the table and lingering over coffee after the plates are cleared. Their upright backs keep you comfortable through a long conversation, and their open frames keep a row of them looking light around the table.

The frames are solid oak, the seats are upholstered and finished with decorative tacks, and each back is left open within its frame, a detail that owes something to the furniture of the 1950s. They arrive fully assembled, ready to pull straight up to the table.

Set a pair at the ends of a dining table, bring them to a kitchen table with a bowl of fruit and the morning's coffee, or stand them either side of a console in a hall. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Monza Leather Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Espresso
input.descriptionHtml:
Monza, just north of Milan, is home to the Villa Reale, built in the late 1770s, and dinner there still carries a touch of villa polish: linen on the table, good glasses and a chair that sits you up straight for conversation. These side chairs are made for that kind of dinner. Their tall backs and slim leather-covered frames keep the table looking neat and orderly, and a 19-inch seat height suits a standard dining table.

Each chair is upholstered in bycast leather, a split cowhide finished with a polished surface coat, tailored by hand over a sturdy wood frame. At just 16 inches wide they fit around a smaller table without crowding, and the leather wipes clean after a spill. They arrive fully assembled.

Gather them around a dining table under a chandelier, with candles, a risotto in the middle and a bottle of red open to breathe, or seat the pair at the head and foot of a long table, facing each other down its length. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Kingham Linen Side Chairs, Set of 2 — In Greige with Chestnut Legs
input.descriptionHtml:
Supper in Kingham, a stone village in the Cotswolds, is a country affair: a roast from the farm shop, the kitchen warm, and friends from down the lane staying long after dessert. These side chairs are made for those long suppers. Their tall backs give you something to lean against between courses, and their softly curved lines and upholstered seats make it easy to stay put until the last of the wine is poured.

Each chair has an oak frame in a distressed finish, upholstered in linen, a natural fibre with a soft, relaxed hand, and edged with a line of decorative tacks that gives the upholstery a neat, tailored border. The seat sits at a standard 19-inch dining height, so they pull up to most tables, and the chairs arrive fully assembled.

Pull them up to a scrubbed farmhouse table with a loaf on a board and a jug of wildflowers, or set them at the heads of a long table with a bench along each side and the candles lit for guests. This set includes two side chairs.

In a village in the Cotswolds like Kingham the kitchen table does most of the living: breakfast, homework, and on a cold night a slow supper by candlelight. These side chairs are built for that table. Their tall upholstered backs support you through a second helping, and the gentle curves of their frames make them as welcome in a kitchen as they are in a dining room.

The frames are oak, distressed so they look well loved from the start, and the seats and backs are upholstered in a soft fabric that brings colour and comfort to a plain wooden table. The seat sits at a 19-inch height that suits a standard dining table, and the chairs arrive fully assembled, ready to pull straight up to the kitchen table.

Set them at a kitchen table with a teapot and a bowl of apples, or put them at the ends of a dining table with candles lit and the casserole in the middle. This set includes two side chairs.

The park at Sceaux, south of Paris, was laid out by André Le Nôtre for Colbert, and on a fine weekend Parisians still bring lunch out to its lawns and stay through the afternoon. These side chairs bring that easy French lunch indoors. Their cane backs let the air through and keep a light, open look around the table, and their tall frames hold you comfortably upright through a long meal.

The frames are beechwood, a close-grained hardwood long favoured by French chairmakers, and the backs are woven cane, strips of rattan skin woven into an open mesh. The seat sits at 21 inches with an 18-inch depth, and the chairs arrive fully assembled.

Pull a pair up to a round table in a breakfast room with a baguette, a dish of butter and a bowl of cherries, or set them either side of a writing desk under a window, with a jar of pens and the day's letters. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Hove Oak Bamboo-Style Side Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
In the tall stucco houses of Hove, weekend breakfast is the slow meal: the coffee pot refilled, the papers spread out and nobody in a hurry to leave the kitchen table. These side chairs are made for that kind of morning. Their slender carved frames draw up close to the table without crowding it, and their linen seats stay comfortable through a second cup and the last of the toast.

Each frame is carved by hand from oak, shaped with the ringed stems of bamboo, and finished in a pale white wash. The seats are upholstered in linen. A 20-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, and the pair comes fully assembled, so the chairs can go straight to the table.

Set them at either end of a long table laid for lunch with a platter of grilled fish and a green salad, or bring the pair to a desk and a dressing table in a guest room, with a folded throw over one seat. This set includes two side chairs.

In the tall stucco houses of Hove, weekend breakfast is the slow meal: the coffee pot refilled, the papers spread out and nobody in a hurry to leave the kitchen table. These side chairs are made for that kind of morning. Their slender carved frames draw up close to the table without crowding it, and their linen seats stay comfortable through a second cup and the last of the toast.

Each frame is carved by hand from oak, shaped with the ringed stems of bamboo, and finished in a pale white wash. The seats are upholstered in linen. A 20-inch seat height suits a standard dining table, and the pair comes fully assembled, so the chairs can go straight to the table.

Set them at either end of a long table laid for lunch with a platter of grilled fish and a green salad, or bring the pair to a desk and a dressing table in a guest room, with a folded throw over one seat. This set includes two side chairs.

On a winter Sunday in Hove, when the wind is up off the Channel and the promenade is nearly empty, lunch moves into a warm dining room and stretches well into the afternoon. These side chairs are made for that long, sheltered meal. Their carved frames keep a light, open look around the table, and their linen seats make it easy to stay put for a second helping and the coffee after.

Each frame is oak, carved by hand with the jointed stems of bamboo and finished in white, and each seat is upholstered in linen. They sit at 20 inches, a comfortable height for a standard dining table, and they are delivered fully assembled, ready for the first lunch.

Set them along both sides of a scrubbed pine or painted table with the roast, a dish of potatoes and a gravy boat, or place one beside a dressing table in a guest room and keep the other in the hall for pulling on boots. This set includes two side chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Cannobio Upholstered Dining Chairs, Set of 2 — In Cream with Cocoa Frame
input.descriptionHtml:
In Cannobio, on the Italian shore of Lake Maggiore near the Swiss border, dinner is taken late by the water, at a table nobody wants to leave while the lights come on across the lake. These dining chairs are made for lingering like that. Their softly rounded backs are upholstered to lean into, and their cushioned seats make a long dinner feel short.

The frames are hardwood, shaped in gentle curves, and the seat and back are covered in chenille performance fabric, a soft, velvety weave made to stand up to everyday life at the table. The tall backs rise to 40.5 inches, giving the chairs a graceful outline around a table and support when you sit back with a last glass. The pair arrives fully assembled.

Set them around a round or oval dining table with candles, a dish of risotto and a bottle of local wine, or use the pair at the two ends of a long table with simpler chairs along the sides. This set includes two dining chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier Valldemossa Carved Beech Dining Chairs, Set of 2
input.descriptionHtml:
Chopin and George Sand spent the winter of 1838 in Valldemossa, high in the mountains of Mallorca, and the village still has the feel of a place where dinner runs long and nobody hurries the last glass. These dining chairs are made for that lingering. Their open backs keep the table looking light and airy, and an upholstered seat stays comfortable through the cheese course and well beyond.

The frames are beech, a close-grained hardwood, carved to mimic the ringed stems of bamboo, a style loved since the Regency. The seats are covered in a soft chenille performance fabric made for easy cleaning, so a splash of wine at dinner is simply blotted away. They arrive fully assembled, ready for the table.

Set them around a dining table in a breakfast room or a dining room, with linen napkins, a bowl of oranges, a basket of bread and candles in glass, or use the pair at either side of a small round table. This set includes two dining chairs.

input.title: BH | Premier East Village Oak and Metal Dining Chair — In Amber with Cream Upholstery
input.descriptionHtml:
In the East Village, dinner is often late and close quarters: a small table in a walk-up apartment, friends squeezed in after work, and a conversation that runs past midnight. This dining chair is made for those late suppers. Its trim frame tucks in close around a small table so another friend can always squeeze in, and its fabric upholstery stays comfortable long after the plates have been pushed aside.

It brings together a metal frame, oak and fabric, so the chair looks light but feels warm to sit in, as much at home in a loft as around an old farmhouse table. Its low 32-inch back keeps the view open across a small room, so even a full table never feels crowded. It arrives fully assembled.

Use a set around a kitchen or dining table, with a candle, a bowl of pasta and an open bottle in the middle, and a spare one by the door for whoever turns up last. Between dinners, pull one up to a desk by the window. This listing is for one dining chair.

input.title: BH | Premier East Village Oak and Metal Counter Stool
input.descriptionHtml:

input.title: BH | Premier East Village Oak and Metal Bar Stool
input.descriptionHtml:
Late in the evening, East Village life moves to the bar: a neighbour's place with stools at a high counter, a last drink poured, and nobody quite ready for the walk home. This bar stool brings that late hour home. At full bar height it puts you level with whoever is mixing the drinks, and its back and low arms hold you comfortably in place for one more round.

Metal, oak and fabric upholstery come together in its frame and seat, and a seat 17 inches deep gives you room to sit back rather than balance on the edge. The arms rise a few inches above the seat, just right for resting an elbow on. It arrives fully assembled.

Set a pair at a home bar or a tall kitchen island, with a shaker, a bowl of olives and a couple of glasses lined up for guests. On quieter nights, one pulled up to the end of the counter makes a good seat for reading the paper while someone else cooks. This listing is for one bar stool.

input.title: BH | Premier Plymouth Notch Leather Swivel Chair
input.descriptionHtml:
Plymouth Notch, the small Vermont hill village where the thirtieth president was born, is a place of long winter evenings, and the chair that suits them best is one that turns: toward the woodstove, toward the window and the snow, toward whoever is talking. This swivel chair is made for that kind of evening. It turns on its base without your getting up, and its 22-inch seat depth lets you settle back for a long while.

It is upholstered in leather over a wood frame, and at just 30 inches wide it suits a smaller room or a pair drawn up by the fire. An 18-inch seat height and arms at 25 inches make it easy to sit down into and easy to rise from. It arrives fully assembled.

Set a pair by a fireplace or woodstove with a small table between them for mugs and a lamp, or put one in the corner of a bedroom or study where it can turn from the desk to the window. This listing is for one swivel chair.
